status: frozen before reading trained-variant validation outcomes
quartiles: sort 65 VLOO cases ascending by true EZ fraction with (fold,subject_id) tie-break; split ordered cases into four nearly equal np.array_split bins
imbalance_direction: Pearson and Spearman between abs(original EZ loss mass-0.5) and patient delta AUPRC; positive is directionally supportive but does not override six quantitative gates
hard_negative_margin: per patient min true EZ score minus maximum score of top16 false EZ NEZ; gain is candidate minus matched control, strictly positive
capacity_gap: FIT patient-mean AUPRC minus VLOO validation patient-mean AUPRC at each excluded patient's selected epoch; gap increase >=0.010 is substantial
topk_tie: stable descending EZ score order with original channel index as tie-break
bootstrap: 10000 patient-case resamples with numpy default_rng(42), percentile 2.5/97.5; cases paired by fold and subject ID
first_positive_trigger: run if both B01-B00 and B11-B10 mean MRR gains are below +0.010
